I’ll check the Anthropic stream conversion and its tests, then fix the tool-call indexes, choice placement, and finish event. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
The converter uses content-block positions as choice indexes and hardcodes every tool-call index to 0. It also repeats the final event for each block. I’ll map content blocks to sequential tool-call indexes and add a regression test for two calls, both with and without preceding text.
Fixed Anthropic streaming to assign sequential tool-call indexes independently of text blocks, keep every chunk in choice 0, and emit the finish event once. This prevents clients from merging separate calls. Non-streaming behavior is unchanged.

Added regression coverage for parallel calls with zero, one, or two preceding text blocks. All 71 tests passed their assertions; pytest’s final reporting hook then hit a sandbox permission error. No dependencies were installed.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text_blocks", [0, 1, 2])
+async def test_chat_stream_parallel_tool_calls(text_blocks):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "test-id",
+                "model": "claude-2.1",
+                "usage": {"input_tokens": 25},
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    for index in range(text_blocks):
+        events.extend([
+            {
+                "type": "content_block_start",
+                "index": index,
+                "content_block": {"type": "text", "text": ""},
+            },
+            {
+                "type": "content_block_delta",
+                "index": index,
+                "delta": {"type": "text_delta", "text": "Checking the weather."},
+            },
+            {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": index},
+        ])
+    for tool_index, location in enumerate(["Singapore", "Tokyo"]):
+        index = text_blocks + tool_index
+        events.append({
+            "type": "content_block_start",
+            "index": index,
+            "content_block": {
+                "type": "tool_use",
+                "id": f"toolu_{tool_index}",
+                "name": "get_weather",
+                "input": {},
+            },
+        })
+        for fragment in ['{"location":', f'"{location}"}}']:
+            events.append({
+                "type": "content_block_delta",
+                "index": index,
+                "delta": {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": fragment},
+            })
+        events.append({"type": "content_block_stop", "index": index})
+    events.extend([

+            "type": "message_delta",

+    ])
+    resp = [f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n\n".encode() for event in events]
+    with mock.patch(

+    ) as mock_post:
+        provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+        payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+        mock_post.assert_called_once()
+
+    assert all(len(chunk.choices) == 1 and chunk.choices[0].index == 0 for chunk in chunks)
+    choices = [chunk.choices[0] for chunk in chunks]
+    assert [choice.finish_reason for choice in choices] == [None] * (len(choices) - 1) + ["stop"]
+    tool_calls = [tool for choice in choices for tool in choice.delta.tool_calls or []]

+    assert [tool.id for tool in tool_calls if tool.id] == ["toolu_0", "toolu_1"]
+    assert [tool.function.name for tool in tool_calls if tool.function.name] == [
